config.objective: Fit supplied UC labels y with sample_weight=abs(p_cnn-p_xgb), using context and expert probabilities. Project the estimated conditional ON probability q onto [min(p_xgb,p_cnn), max(p_xgb,p_cnn)]. This is the blend-interval BCE optimum if q is accurate; AUC is evaluated separately. Equal experts have zero fitting weight and an unchanged final prediction.
config.protocol: Freeze this configuration before fitting. 2021 gate uses 2020 OOF; 2022 gate uses 2020/2021 OOF; purge any OOF case whose 168-hour horizon crosses the evaluation-year boundary. Final gate uses all 2020/2021/2022 OOF. No early stopping, evaluation fitting, or hyperparameter search.
config.normalization: Scale is max(population standard deviation of the supplied 168-hour price profile, 1 EUR/MWh). Preserve absolute weekly mean and scale alongside relative price, scaled terminal local water value and scaled margin.
config.final_sources: The same five equal-weight 600-tree XGBoost experts and one seed-42 20-epoch CNN used in the OOF folds. Do not replace the final CNN with the stronger five-seed ensemble.
config.evaluation_note: Historical years are development backtests; 2022 has influenced earlier project decisions. The current five-seed reference has different training budgets and is not a matched comparison.
config.unprojected_probability_diagnostic: Score the same frozen meta-model before interval projection on historical evaluation only. No additional model fitting, submission output, or hyperparameter selection.
